messages:
mia-support: heads up — getting a stack of tickets where support console 'Apply credits' hangs on 'Applying...' and eventually errors out. customer reported 502 from our admin API and their trial never activated.

aj-eng: can you paste the console trace or recent request id?

mia-support: example request id: req_20260303_9f2b. UI shows spinner for ~30s then 'Failed to apply'. I tried twice, same result. Customer: @acme-inc (SaaS).

sam-billing: seeing a spike in failed grant attempts in the last 10m. Backend returned 502 and 429 in some cases. Not sure if rate-limiter or db lock.

kai-backoffice: backoffice-bot shows long-running mutation for grants. Checking logs...

backoffice-bot: [alert] mutation.apply_credit (req_20260303_9f2b) start=2026-03-03T15:04:23Z status=IN_PROGRESS

kai-backoffice: found a deadlocked transaction on grants table around that time. stack: 
```
txn 0x3fa lock wait timeout: deadlock in apply_credit -> apply_billing_changes -> update_account_balance
```

aj-eng: interesting. any recent deploys to backoffice?

michael-sre: rolled runtime 2026-03-03 14:50UTC (svc/backoffice) — nothing flagged in deploy bot. I'll correlate.

jenna-qa: can reproduce locally: run backoffice apply flow twice concurrently for same account id -> UI hangs and second request returns 502 after lock wait. Single request succeeds.

aj-eng: likely race on idempotency token or missing unique constraint on grant_token. Is the admin console retrying without idempotency?

kai-backoffice: console uses a generated grant_id but it wasn't passed down to the mutation consistently; some code paths call applyCredit() without the id. If backend sees null it creates new rows and update_balance does SELECT FOR UPDATE causing lock.

sam-billing: can we short-term stop console retries? Customers still blocked.

aj-eng: workaround: add a quick guard in backoffice proxy to reject concurrent apply attempts for the same account with 409 if a pending grant exists. I can patch and release a hotfix. Alternatively we can run manual DB reconciliation to grant credits for the impacted customers.

michael-sre: I'd prefer the hotfix first; manual DB writes are risky during business hours. Also need a detection query to find stuck apply records.

kai-backoffice: detection query: 
```sql
SELECT id, account_id, status, created_at FROM grants WHERE status='PENDING' AND created_at < now() - interval '2 minutes';
```
Found ~18 rows in staging; 3 in prod so far.

mia-support: list of affected accounts: acme-inc (acct_321), beta-co (acct_992). They need trials activated today.

aj-eng: I'll push a tiny change to backoffice proxy: if grant with same external_request_id exists and status != FAILED, return 409 with message 'grant in progress'. Will deploy canary to staging now.

backoffice-bot: deploy started: backoffice-proxy v2026-03-03-hotfix-1 -> canary us-west-2

michael-sre: routing canary 5% done. Monitoring locks and 5xx on grant endpoints.

jenna-qa: staging repro after hotspot fix: concurrent apply now returns 409 on second request and first finishes successfully. 

aj-eng: rolling to prod now. patch is tiny — adds check + short-circuit. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/backoffice/pull/482

backoffice-bot: deploy success: backoffice-proxy v2026-03-03-hotfix-1 -> prod

kai-backoffice: production detection query now shows pending rows cleared as jobs completed. We had to manually mark 2 rows as FAILED and re-run the grant job for those accounts via admin-runbook. Workaround documented: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/grants-apply-workaround

mia-support: Customer acme-inc confirmed credits applied after we ran the job. Thanks team! :tada:

aj-eng: root cause: missing propagation of idempotency/external_request_id on a new codepath when console exposes 'apply' inline. Race created two create/update sequences causing lock and eventual timeout. Fix ensures idempotency token is required and enforced.

sam-billing: adding regression test to billing/e2e to simulate concurrent apply for same account.

jenna-qa: also adding a unit test for admin console path to ensure token is passed in all flows.

aj-eng: follow-ups: 1) add 5m alert for >5 PENDING grants older than 2m 2) include grant request id in support console logs 3) postmortem note. I'll open tickets.

aj-eng: opened tickets: ENG-1209 (alerts), ENG-1210 (console logging), ENG-1211 (e2e test).

mia-support: closing loop with customers now. thanks everyone.

michael-sre: marking incident resolved in ops tracker. will add SLA hit calc to postmortem.

jenna-qa: QA will run a sweep tomorrow to ensure no regressions.

mia-support: final note — please add short blurb to support playbook about when to run the manual grant job and the exact detection query. saved us twice today.
